cards.example_en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
cards.example_zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。
cards.explain_zh: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。

cards.example_en: These photos prove that our dog opened the cupboard.
cards.example_zh: 这些照片证明是我们的狗打开了橱柜。
cards.explain_zh: prove可接that从句，也可直接接形容词。

cards.example_en: I found a cent under the sofa cushion.
cards.example_zh: 我在沙发坐垫下面找到了一枚一分硬币。
cards.explain_zh: cent是可数名词；金额超过一分通常用cents。

cards.example_en: For households with limited incomes, every cent saved on essential goods can contribute to greater financial security.
cards.example_zh: 对收入有限的家庭而言，购买必需品时省下的每一分钱都能增强经济保障。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
cards.example_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。
cards.explain_zh: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

cards.example_en: My keys fell onto the kitchen floor again.
cards.example_zh: 我的钥匙又掉到厨房地板上了。
cards.explain_zh: 英式first floor是二楼；美式first floor是一楼。

cards.example_en: Please move your stuff off the kitchen table.
cards.example_zh: 请把你的东西从厨房餐桌上拿走。
cards.explain_zh: 名词stuff不可数且偏口语；正式写作宜用具体名词。

cards.example_en: The sofa will not fit through this wide doorway.
cards.example_zh: 即使门口这么宽，这张沙发也搬不进去。
cards.explain_zh: wide表示张开程度；widely常表示广泛地。

cards.example_en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
cards.example_zh: 任何人都可以参加我们周末的河边散步活动。
cards.explain_zh: 作主语时谓语用单数；any one强调任意一个。

cards.example_en: Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.
cards.example_zh: 公共图书馆应向任何有需要的人免费提供互联网服务，不论其收入如何。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This method keeps my herbs fresh for several days.
cards.example_zh: 这个方法能让我的香草保鲜好几天。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a method of/for doing sth表示做事的方法。

cards.example_en: A soil analysis showed why my plants were struggling.
cards.example_zh: 土壤分析揭示了我的植物长势不佳的原因。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为analyses；英式动词为analyse。

cards.example_en: Our club is holding an election for its next chair.
cards.example_zh: 我们俱乐部正在举行选举，选出下一任主席。
cards.explain_zh: elect强调投票选出；select泛指挑选。

cards.example_en: We watched military helicopters carry supplies to the island.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着军用直升机把物资运往岛上。
cards.explain_zh: 作名词指整体军队时，通常用the military。

cards.example_en: Governments must balance military spending with investment in essential public services such as healthcare and education.
cards.example_zh: 政府必须平衡军事开支与医疗、教育等基本公共服务的投入。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our hotel room overlooks a quiet sandy beach.
cards.example_zh: 我们住的酒店房间可以俯瞰一片宁静的沙滩。
cards.explain_zh: 表示住酒店可用stay at或stay in a hotel。

cards.example_en: I joined a chess club to meet new people.
cards.example_zh: 我加入了一个国际象棋俱乐部，想认识些新朋友。
cards.explain_zh: join a club表示加入社团，不用join in a club。

cards.example_en: Our cat sleeps on the shelf below the window.
cards.example_zh: 我们的猫睡在窗户下方的架子上。
cards.explain_zh: below强调位置或数值较低，不一定在正下方。

cards.example_en: We watched a funny movie after dinner last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚晚饭后，我们看了一部有趣的电影。
cards.explain_zh: movie偏美式，英式常用film；the movies可指电影院。

cards.example_en: The doctor listened carefully as I described my symptoms.
cards.example_zh: 我描述症状时，医生认真地听着。
cards.explain_zh: 看医生常说see a doctor；动词doctor可指篡改。

cards.example_en: We had a lively discussion about our holiday plans.
cards.example_zh: 我们热烈讨论了度假计划。
cards.explain_zh: 名词可接about或of；动词discuss后直接接话题。

cards.example_en: I'm sorry I spilled juice on your clean shirt.
cards.example_zh: 很抱歉，我把果汁洒在了你的干净衬衫上。
cards.explain_zh: sorry for doing表示为所做之事道歉。

cards.example_en: Cooking dinner for twelve guests was quite a challenge.
cards.example_zh: 给十二位客人做晚饭真是个不小的挑战。
cards.explain_zh: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

cards.example_en: Fans across the nation celebrated the team's victory.
cards.example_zh: 全国各地的球迷都在庆祝这支球队获胜。
cards.explain_zh: nation强调国家及人民，state常强调政权或政治实体。

cards.example_en: I nearly missed the bus because I overslept.
cards.example_zh: 我睡过了头，差点没赶上公交车。
cards.explain_zh: nearly表示差一点达到；not nearly表示远远不。

cards.example_en: Nearly half of the surveyed residents supported expanding public transport rather than building additional roads.
cards.example_zh: 受访居民中近一半支持扩建公共交通系统，而不是增建道路。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her statement about the broken window surprised everyone.
cards.example_zh: 她关于那扇破窗的说法让所有人都很惊讶。
cards.explain_zh: 作“陈述”时是可数名词；银行对账单也用statement。

cards.example_en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
cards.example_zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a link between A and B；动词用link A to/with B。

cards.example_en: The new bridge provides a link between the villages.
cards.example_zh: 这座新桥连接了这些村庄。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We enjoyed our walk despite the cold wind.
cards.example_zh: 尽管寒风吹拂，我们还是散步散得很开心。
cards.explain_zh: 后接名词或动名词，不加of；接从句用the fact that。

cards.example_en: Let me introduce you to my new neighbour.
cards.example_zh: 让我把你介绍给我的新邻居。
cards.explain_zh: 把甲介绍给乙用introduce A to B，不能用with。

cards.example_en: Your long arms give you an advantage in swimming.
cards.example_zh: 你的长手臂让你在游泳时更有优势。
cards.explain_zh: take advantage of可指利用机会，也可指占人便宜。

cards.example_en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭好了，请把你的盘子拿来。
cards.explain_zh: ready for后接名词；ready to后接动词原形。

cards.example_en: My cousin plans to marry her partner next spring.
cards.example_zh: 我表姐计划明年春天与伴侣结婚。
cards.explain_zh: 说marry someone或get married to，不说marry with。

cards.example_en: The drivers are on strike, so we walked home.
cards.example_zh: 司机们正在罢工，所以我们走路回了家。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式struck；过去分词通常也用struck。

cards.example_en: Workers may go on strike when negotiations over pay and working conditions fail.
cards.example_zh: 当有关薪酬和工作条件的谈判失败时，工人可能会举行罢工。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
cards.example_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。
cards.explain_zh: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

cards.example_en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
cards.example_zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: You should seek advice before buying a used car.
cards.example_zh: 买二手车之前，你应该征求意见。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。

cards.example_en: You should seek advice before buying a used car.
cards.example_zh: 买二手车之前，你应该征求意见。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her ability to fix bicycles impressed all her friends.
cards.example_zh: 她修自行车的本领让朋友们都很佩服。
cards.explain_zh: 表示“做某事的能力”用ability to do。

cards.example_en: We finished the first unit before our lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 我们在午休前学完了第一个单元。
cards.explain_zh: 表示计量单位时常用a unit of，后接所计量的事物。

cards.example_en: I tapped my card to pay for the groceries.
cards.example_zh: 我刷卡支付了买食品杂货的钱。
cards.explain_zh: play cards指打牌，cards用复数，前面不加冠词。

cards.example_en: She works as a nurse at the local hospital.
cards.example_zh: 她在当地医院当护士。
cards.explain_zh: 住院：英式in hospital，美式in the hospital。

cards.example_en: We quickly packed our bags when the taxi arrived.
cards.example_zh: 出租车一到，我们就迅速收拾好了行李。
cards.explain_zh: quickly是副词，修饰动作；quick是形容词，修饰名词。

cards.example_en: Cities must respond quickly to extreme weather events to protect vulnerable residents and maintain essential services.
cards.example_zh: 城市必须迅速应对极端天气事件，以保护弱势居民并维持基本服务。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
cards.example_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。
cards.explain_zh: interviewer是提问者；interviewee是接受面试或采访者。

cards.example_en: I practised answering questions before my first job interview.
cards.example_zh: 第一次求职面试前，我练习了如何回答问题。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We reached an agreement about sharing the kitchen.
cards.example_zh: 我们就共用厨房达成了协议。
cards.explain_zh: 具体协议可数；表示意见一致时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
cards.example_zh: 政府应公布可靠的环境数据，让公民能够评估气候政策的成效。
cards.explain_zh: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

word.meaning_zh: 各种各样的；范围广泛的
word.example_en: The library provides a wide range of learning materials.
word.example_zh: 图书馆提供各种各样的学习材料。

word.example_en: Many graduates seek employment abroad to gain professional experience and develop their language skills.
word.example_zh: 许多毕业生到国外求职，以积累职业经验并提升语言技能。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
